name: Vampire - Multiattack (Vampire Form Only) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a action

results.text: The vampire lunges with a chilling hiss, fangs glistening in the moonlit shadows.
Shadows writhe as the undead lord readies twin strikes with eerie precision.
A gust of decayed air precedes his dual assault, eyes burning crimson.
Cloaked in darkness, the vampire's claws and fangs gleam like obsidian blades.
His form blurs into a spectral blur, teeth bared for a deadly embrace.
